mcp.title: MCP connection
mcp.subtitle: Connect AI agents to Reinforce over the Model Context Protocol. Agents can browse content and submit proposals; nothing they send is published without your review.
mcp.stdioHint: For agents running on this machine. Replace the paths with your binary, database and blob directory.
mcp.httpHintInvite: For remote agents. Every call needs a named agent token as a Bearer token; proposals record the token name as the submitter.
mcp.httpHintSingle: Single-user mode accepts loopback connections without a token. Use invite mode to expose MCP beyond this machine.
mcp.tokensSingleMode: Agent tokens are only used in invite mode (reinforce serve --auth invite). In single-user mode, local HTTP clients connect without one.
mcp.tokensOwnerOnly: Only the owner can create or revoke agent tokens. Ask the owner for a token to connect an agent.
